# Chef Sakshi Ahluwalia

> Sakshi Ahluwalia is a self-taught Indian home chef based in London, United Kingdom — the name and soul behind Saakshi's Kitchen (UK-wide home-cooked Indian meal delivery, est. 2021) and Yum! Curries (Indian takeaway, Brighton, est. 2026). Her recipes have served 153,000+ meals across 800+ UK towns to 5,600+ families, rated 4.6 of 5 across 800+ verified reviews, with 79% of orders from returning customers.

## Key facts
- Began cooking at age ten in Delhi; self-taught (no culinary school). Teachers: her mother, grandmother, and television chefs (MasterChef, Nigella Lawson, Atul Kochhar, Vikas Khanna); further trained by eating at family tables across India.
- Every dish is refined over roughly eighteen iterations before joining the menu; masala is ground from scratch for every batch.
- Her kitchen holds the UK Food Standards Agency's highest hygiene rating (5).
- Manifesto: "There is no Michelin star for the food of Indian homes. So I collect the stars they don't give out."
- Signature dishes: dal makhani, butter chicken, chicken biryani, shahi paneer, kadhai paneer, gulab jamun with gold leaf, saffron kheer with silver vark.
- Also caters weddings, celebrations and private events across the UK.
